camel_example: aliyun ims UpdateLoginProfile --region cn-hangzhou --Status Active --PasswordResetRequired false --UserPrincipalName 'test@example.onaliyun.com' --MFABindRequired false --Password mypassword
description_en: Modifies the console logon information of a specified Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: 修改指定RAM用户的控制台登录信息
kebab_example: aliyun ims update-login-profile --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --password mypassword --password-reset-required false --mfa-bind-required false --status Active --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLoginProfile

parameters.help_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The new console logon password of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The password must meet the password strength requirements
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的控制台登录新密码。

密码必须符合密码强度要求
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to reset the password at the next logon. Valid values:

true
false
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户在下次登录时是否必须重置密码。取值：

true
false
parameters.name: password_reset_required

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Resource Access Management (RAM) user is required to enable multi-factor authentication (MFA). Valid values:

true: MFA is required. The RAM user must attach an MFA device at the next logon.
false: MFA is not required
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制要求RAM用户开启多因素认证。取值：

true：要求开启。RAM用户在下次登录时必须绑定多因素认证设备。
false：不要求开启
parameters.name: mfa_bind_required

parameters.help_en:
Enables or disables console password logon. Valid values:

Active: enables console password logon.
Inactive: disables console password logon
parameters.help_zh:
开启或禁用控制台密码登录。取值：

Active：开启。
Inactive：禁用
parameters.name: status
